section_summary.extract_value: This limitations section notes that the study is correlational and cross-sectional, preventing causal inferences, and recommends longitudinal designs and control of extraneous variables. It flags measurement and recall limitations (e.g., retrospective reports of caregivers' eating messages and self-reported height/weight) and the homogeneity of the sample, describing participants as mainly White, young adult, middle-class, first-year college women and urging replication in more diverse samples.
